scope: Uganda–South Sudan named land crossings and documented border service locations; source benchmark independent of OSM candidate generation
coverage_limitations: This is a bounded primary-source benchmark, not a comprehensive census of all formal and informal crossings.
Source-verified means the named location is documented at the stated source date, not that it is currently open or affected by any closure event.
UNHCR2021 points can represent control facilities offset from a mapped boundary; unknown source accuracy is retained. Large mismatches are unresolved, not corrected by snapping.
No rail or ferry crossing on this frontier was established by the reviewed sources. Absence from this list is not proof that such connections do not exist.
Owino-Drewu versus Aweno-Olwiyo and Musingo versus Madi Opei remain unresolved alias questions; they are not counted as additional distinct crossings.
Opposite-side operation areas from URA are preserved as pair labels, not automatically treated as colocated facilities.
Boundary alignment/disputes are documented in government sources; this benchmark does not adjudicate them.

UNHCR coordinates are externally published reference positions. Their collection method, per-point observation date, accuracy and independence from OSM are undocumented; publication date is not observation date.

findings: Three of ten independently documented named locations have supported OSM corridor associations, five have provisional associations and two have no accepted candidate match. These are identity/geometry review outcomes, not measured extraction precision or recall.
Waligo is outside the major-road sample although independently documented; road-class filtering alone misses important named locations.
The six URA operation areas were discovered from an institutional list before matching candidates, avoiding a benchmark limited to OSM successes.
The loose original name matcher attached Elegu events to a different same-name settlement around 30 km west of the Amuru crossing. Country pair alone is not a sufficient disambiguator.
The nineteen Yei–Koboko A8 contacts occur along CD/UG, while actual Oraba/Kaya has its own SS/UG candidate.

Facilities and boundary intersections differ by 4.1 km at Aweno-Olwiyo, 7.7 km at Ngomoromo and 9.8 km at Waligo. Road continuity supports corridor leads but cannot resolve boundary placement or exact post identity.
